async function work() {
for (const item of items) {
  callbacks.push(async () => {
    await read(item);
  });
  // ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
  await read(item);
  callbacks.push(async () => {
    for (const item of items) {
      // ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
      await read(item);
    }
  });
}
}
